_readme: Copy to safe-owners.json (gitignored) and fill in. Input to the three PM-D4
scripts, in order: verifySignerCandidates.mjs, createOwnerSafe.mjs,
verifyOwnerSafe.mjs.
HOW TO COLLECT THIS. Send each candidate two links:
· SECURITY.md — what the Safe can and cannot do, and the no-withdraw guarantee
· https://jayoo101.github.io/tosh-status/sign/ — one button
That page exists because MetaMask has no 'sign a message' button in its
interface, and because a signer who retypes the message by hand produces a
signature over different bytes the moment they add a space. The page holds
the text, they press one button, and it hands them a JSON block shaped like
the entries below. Paste the three blocks straight into `signers`.
The message sits at the top level here, once, so that anyone opening this
file can see the exact text without hunting for it. The page emits a copy
inside each signer block instead, so the text travels with the signature
covering it; when you paste those blocks in, the per-signer copy is what
counts and this top-level one is ignored. Both shapes work. What the
scripts insist on is that all three signers agree, because three people
who signed three different statements have each proved control of a key
without all having accepted the same role.
THE MESSAGE NAMES A CHAIN AND A DATE, AND BOTH ARE LOAD-BEARING. The chain
is what makes this consent to a specific deployment rather than to the
word 'Tosh'; the date is what stops a signature collected for one round
being replayed into the next. So changing either one invalidates the round
before it: signatures over the old text still prove control of their keys,
but they no longer record acceptance of the role as now stated, and they
have to be collected again.
The exact same string is hardcoded as `const MESSAGE` in sign/index.html in
jayoo101/tosh-status, because the page is what people actually sign from.
Edit both on the same day. `checkStatusPage.mjs` check 7a compares them and
goes red the moment only one moves — and 7b now also reads the text, since
for the whole Infinity port both copies agreed on '(2-of-3, Robinhood Chain
4663)' and 7a was green the entire time.
NEVER put a private key or seed phrase in this file. The scripts refuse to
run if they find one, and rightly: a signer key that has been transmitted is
no longer a signer key. Nobody entitled to ask you for one will ask.
Addresses and signatures are not secret — both are about to be public on
chain. The real file is gitignored only because it names people.
